event_logic_failure_analysis.systematic_offset: All predictions ~1.43–1.47s too late — same event structure found in post-dive portion
event_logic_failure_analysis.detail: At GT takeoff (3.120s), smoothed velocity = -0.011/s. Event Logic V2.1 requires takeoff_vel_threshold=0.04/s (sustained). The genuine dive flight arc generates only 0.011/s velocity at 360p resolution (7px vertical over 0.45s). Post-dive activity (t>4.5s) generates 0.045-0.096/s signals that the algorithm identifies as the dive sequence instead.

next_required_work: 1. Process Paris canary at 1080p (original resolution) to get 3x velocity signal
2. OR: calibrate EL velocity thresholds for 360p input in a dedicated param set
3. Verify that at 1080p, velocity at takeoff exceeds 0.04/s threshold
4. Post-dive isolation (truncate trajectory at estimated water_contact) to avoid noise from subsequent activity
